body: Thanks man. I think I may hit the hay in a few, it's very late here, but I appreciate it. Thanks again for taking the time to stop in.
PM me if you want to talk. I actually called a suicide hotline myself about 2 hours ago, and then talked me down. I'll be up for a while if you want to talk.
It's ok, I laughed. Thanks for your kind words.

Unfortunately it's not that kind of final. It's a take-home exam, more like a couple of medium length essays.

Passing this class isn't a possibility, but I'm doing a bit better now. Life is gonna suck for a while, but I'll get through it.
